params.body:
## What was wrong

The Garages tab of Beheer > Inzichten did not finish loading on production (or took very long).

`GarageHealth` reads the sales of every garage and leaves out the ones that went to a colleague. It asked that per sold car, with a correlated `NOT EXISTS` on `vehicles.seller_vehicle_id`, a column without an index: the whole vehicles table was read once for every sold car, and twice over (the first-and-last query and the per-day query). On the demo data that is invisible; on production it is millions of row reads. The Momentum tab had the same pattern and was fixed before it merged; this one was missed.

## What changes

- The set of bought-over cars is read once and joined against (`LEFT JOIN … IS NULL`), so the result is the same and the cost is one pass.
- A migration adds an index on `vehicles.seller_vehicle_id`, guarded so it can run twice. The column is asked about in several places (buy-overs, platform copies); every one of them was a table scan.

## Checked

- `GarageHealthTest`, `MomentumTest`, `EveryInsightsTabStandsOnOnePatternTest`, `PlatformStaffAreNotAGarageTest`: 31 tests green on a database built from the dump plus this migration.
- Not timed on production-sized data: there is no such copy locally. After the deploy the first load of the Garages tab is the check; the result is cached for an hour.
- The full suite was not run locally for this two-file change; CI is the judge.

## Deploy

One migration: an index on the vehicles table. It is a short lock on a table of some tens of thousands of rows.
params.title: Insights: the Garages tab loads (buy-overs read once, index on seller_vehicle_id)
